findings.desc: quality-cleanup: validate-docs-drift.ts:251 ALL_MANAGED_ASSET_KINDS is a manually-duplicated copy of the ManagedAssetKind union from managed-assets.ts with no exported runtime array to derive from; if a new kind is added to ManagedAssetKind, the runtime guard at line 383 (!ALL_MANAGED_ASSET_KINDS.has(kind)) will silently skip defs with that kind rather than treating them as generated assets — the Handler Encoding Convention re-validation set can drift from the canonical type without a compile-time error
